gloss: finally; at last; more and more

definitions.gloss: finally; at last; at long last
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something anticipated is about to happen or has begun.
Indicates that something is intensifying or becoming more pronounced.

examples.japanese: いよいよ⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is finally the real thing.

examples.japanese: いよいよ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新学期|しんがっき}→新学期：16070_shingakki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The new semester finally starts tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、いよいよ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: After long preparations, the opening day has finally arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いよいよ⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦きた→くる：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The rain has become increasingly intense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いよいよ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The situation is becoming more and more serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まり→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧、いよいよ⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦きた→くる：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Autumn has deepened, and it's getting colder and colder.

notes:
TWO MAIN MEANINGS:

1) "Finally/at last" - Used when an anticipated moment arrives
・いよいよ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: It's finally departure time

2) "More and more" - Indicates intensification
・いよいよ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become more and more serious

NUANCE: Often carries a sense of anticipation, excitement, or urgency. Can imply that something important is about to happen after a period of waiting.
